config.text: Google Workspace tools are installed. When the user's request involves their Gmail (read/search/send/draft/reply/labels), Calendar (list events/create/RSVP/free-busy), Drive (list/search/read/upload files), Docs (create/read/edit), Sheets (read ranges/append rows), or Tasks/Contacts, call the matching `gmail.*` / `calendar.*` / `drive.*` / `docs.*` / `sheets.*` tool rather than asking the user to do it manually or refusing for lack of access. The user has already connected their Google account via OAuth — no need to ask for credentials.

edges.when: let t = event.payload.text.to_lower(); t.contains("gmail") || t.contains("email") || t.contains("calendar") || t.contains("meeting") || t.contains("schedule") || t.contains("drive") || t.contains("docs") || t.contains("document") || t.contains("sheet") || t.contains("spreadsheet") || t.contains("inbox") || t.contains("event") || t.contains("invite")
